episodes.title: Red Light, Green Light
episodes.summary: Kicking off this reality competition, hundreds of hopefuls in tracksuits set out to cross the finish line during a game of "Red Light, Green Light."

episodes.title: The Man With The Umbrella
episodes.summary: Cracks in the competition begin to show during "Dalgona," a game that shapes up to be a daunting endeavor amid sweet victories and painful extractions.

episodes.title: War
episodes.summary: After a player desperately tries to coax another to pick up a phone, the rest prepare for the next challenge and form teams based on brawn and bonds.

episodes.title: Nowhere To Hide
episodes.summary: Dorm elimination tests rattle the remaining players, who rush to find solutions — and avoid becoming targets. A chores session puts two allies on edge.

episodes.title: Trick Or Treat
episodes.summary: A tempting treat motivates the group to chip in with a chore. But a pleasant picnic in the dorm takes a devastating turn when the next game is revealed.

episodes.title: Goodbye
episodes.summary: With marbles in hand, players are forced to face off against friends and bid tearful farewells. As the money piles up, another elimination test looms.

episodes.title: Friend And Foe
episodes.summary: After drawing numbers to determine the order in which they will cross the glass bridge, the players consider their options before taking a leap of faith.

episodes.title: One Step Closer
episodes.summary: As the clock ticks, the players move quickly to get to the other side of the bridge. Back in the dormitory, evading elimination becomes a dicey mission.

episodes.title: Circle Of Trust
episodes.summary: A nomination from the previous game puts players at odds. Emotions run high in a guessing game centered on trust. Who will make it to the final round?

episodes.title: One Lucky Day
episodes.summary: As the end draws near, the finalists suit up for a lavish feast — and a surprising test. One last game stands between a player and the ultimate prize.

episodes.title: Six Legs
episodes.summary: When 456 new players enter the competition, they quickly learn why every second will count. A nerve-wracking pentathlon whittles down the field.

episodes.title: Catch
episodes.summary: The players face a moral quandary about their weakest links. As meal time approaches, they get a tasty treat — but in this game, there's always a catch.

episodes.title: The Doll
episodes.summary: With everything on the line, which players will drop the ball? A mysterious object appears in the dormitory, sparking a flurry of strategy and suspicion.

episodes.title: Mingle
episodes.summary: A bold bet forces everyone to choose sides. A frantic game of "Mingle" slams the door on key alliances. The players discover the high price of rebellion.

episodes.title: Sacrifice
episodes.summary: A head-to-head game forces tearful sacrifices and goodbyes. A trio of leaders emerge in the dormitory, but will sweet perks put a target on their backs?

episodes.title: Ups & Downs
episodes.summary: After a contender overplays their hand, nobody wants to be the odd player out. Who will climb ahead in the next game — and who will slide to elimination?

episodes.title: Trust
episodes.summary: Emotions boil over during a dicey race to survive. As rivalries intensify, the players enter the "Circle of Trust" for a ruthless game of truth and lies.

episodes.title: Faith
episodes.summary: The players put on their best poker faces, but who will bluff their way to victory? A deceptively simple game determines who will advance to the finale.

episodes.title: Red Light Green Light
episodes.summary: In this $4.56 million showdown, the Squid Game finalists suit up for a winner-take-all edition of "Red Light, Green Light" with a life-changing prize.
